en:
You travel all over the place,
don't you?\pYou're not driving your POKéMON
too harshly, are you?\pLet me take a look.
… … …   … … …
Oh, impressive.\nYou treat your POKéMON right.\pI think you can be entrusted with\nthis.\pPlease, I'd like you to have this.
…Unfortunately, you don't have\nspace for this in your party.\pYou'd better come back for it\nanother time.
I received that EGG while I was\ntraveling.\pI'm glad I met someone like you.

Oh, hello.
That's a cute {STR_VAR_2}.\pSeeing it reminds me of a sweet 
little girl I met while traveling.\pShe was gently grooming POKéMON…
She was a little angel.\pThat little girl's name…
I think it was DAISY.
This is an excellent environment\nfor raising POKéMON.
Your POKéMON are growing up\nadmirably well!
You know, I think you have the\ntalent to be a good BREEDER.
